item.text: {"case_id":"SHC095","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C17","C04","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":"C17","confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C17 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. It uses the same section 22 sequence: advice from the Secretary of Agriculture, a presidential request for a Tariff Commission investigation, Commission findings and recommendations, a presidential finding of threatened interference with a price-support program, a declaration that quantitative restrictions are necessary, and an operative aggregate-pound quota for a current period and subsequent years followed by the statutory 50-percent representative-period comparison. The child closely adapts that machinery and language from butterfat products to prespinning cotton products. C04 and C11 are also strong quota precedents, especially for the operative aggregate-limit and proportionality language, but their quotas are limited to a single crop-year period and contain additional country allocations or exemptions absent from the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Secretary of Agriculture advised the President that he had reason to believe that certain cotton products ... are being or are practically certain to be imported ... under such conditions and in such quantities as to render or tend to render ineffective, or materially interfere with, the price-support program","parent_excerpt":"the Secretary of Agriculture advised me that there was reason to believe that butter substitutes ... are practically certain to be imported ... under such conditions and in such quantities as to render or tend to render ineffective, or materially interfere with, the price-support program","explanation":"Distinctive parallel opening recital establishing the same section 22 factual predicate, with the commodity and associated agricultural program substituted."},{"child_excerpt":"on the basis of the investigation and report of the Tariff Commission, I materially interfere with, the price-support program","parent_excerpt":"on the basis of the said investigation and report of the Tariff Commission, I find that butter substitutes ... are practically certain to be imported ... as to materially interfere with the said price-support program","explanation":"The child follows the same Commission-report-to-presidential-finding transition and adapts the finding to cotton products."},{"child_excerpt":"I find and declare that the import restrictions hereinafter proclaimed are shown by such investigation of the Tariff Commission to be necessary in order declare that the imposition of the quantitative limitations hereinafter proclaimed is shown by such investigation of the said Tariff Commission to be necessary in order that the entry, or withdrawal from warehouse, for consumption ... will not materially interfere with the said price-support program","explanation":"This is a close, concrete parallel in the necessity recital, including its impose recurring aggregate pound ceilings through nearly identical entry-or-warehouse-withdrawal machinery, including application to subsequent years."},{"child_excerpt":"which permissible total
